I built a personalized signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FloQast needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to other fintech software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
